routing._comment: P2-T3 routing v1 (D3's ladder in product). Band derived from 8 re-lock runs (2026-07-15): failures cluster at gs-024's dead-constant 0.98; pass median 4.70; shelf analysis showed identical failure-capture at 1.0/1.5/2.0. Upper cutoff 1.5 per director amendment = drift headroom for 0.98 (0.52 vs 0.02), incremental cost ONE recurring question (gs-011 @ 1.39). Escalates ~6 of 31 exam questions.
